Cricketer Jemimah Rodrigues Hugs Pakistan Captain Fatima Sana

Indian cricketer Jemimah Rodrigues was seen hugging Pakistan captain Fatima Sana. A video of the interaction went viral on social media. Fans reacted strongly to the footage, with some expressing anger. The incident occurred following a match, and the embrace was captured on camera.
